Bhandara Style Kaddu Ki Sabzi, sweet, tangy, and seriously addictive when made the right way! This version has that perfect Bhandara/Halwai-style flavour, with no onion or garlic and the simplest prep.
It takes just 20 minutes to make and tastes amazing with hot, fluffy puris. I’m sure you’ll enjoy this one even if you’re not usually a kaddu fan! The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description, along with the link for making the best puris. Do give it a try. Happy Cooking!
